identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study Of Palbociclib (PD-0332991) + Letrozole VS. Placebo+ Letrozole For 1st Line Treatment Of Asian Postmenopausal Women With ER+/HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer [PALOMA-4]
identificationModule.officialTitle: A MULTICENTER, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND PHASE 3 STUDY OF PALBOCICLIB (ORAL CDK 4/6 INHIBITOR) PLUS LETROZOLE VERSUS PLACEBO PLUS LETROZOLE FOR THE TREATMENT OF PREVIOUSLY UNTREATED ASIAN POSTMENOPAUSAL WOMEN WITH ER (+), HER2 (-) ADVANCED BREAST CANCER

armGroups.label: Palbociclib + Letrozole
armGroups.description: Palbociclib, 125mg, orally once daily on Day 1 to Day 21 of every 28-day cycle followed by 7 days off treatment in combination with Letrozole, 2.5mg, orally once daily (continuously)

armGroups.label: Placebo + Letrozole
armGroups.description: Placebo, 125mg, orally once daily on Day 1 to Day 21 of every 28-day cycle followed by 7 days off treatment in combination with Letrozole, 2.5mg, orally once daily (continuously).
